name: idea-space
description: Generate verifiably new ideas in any domain: map everything that exists by meaning, find the empty space, write the idea that would live there, and measure how far it lands from its closest existing twin.

interface.shortDescription: Find the empty space in a domain and measure how new an idea is.
interface.longDescription: Embed a corpus of everything that exists in a domain, survey its neighbourhoods, blend related items or find holes between neighbourhoods, write the idea that would live there, and re-embed it to measure its distance from the closest existing item before ranking.
defaultPrompt: Give me genuinely new game ideas that nothing on Steam already does.
Map this product catalogue and show me where the white space is.
How original is this idea compared with what already exists?
